conclusion: PASS with explicit limited scope. The final light silver-gray opaque skin is closer to daylight evidence than the darker early feasibility probe. Window backing contrast and the two directly photographed skin faces provide a real, moderate front/adjacent-side benefit. Rear and top intentionally gain little or no color. Not a whole-building accurate material reconstruction.

Undercroft and mesh screen: outer metal and inner glass/stairs must not become one transparent face.
Undercroft cores, exposed beams and central stairs; these unselected surfaces remain neutral.
Open concrete passage and stairs are not glass.
Direct short-face view: the high narrow ribbon is glazed; the large lower dark balcony/deep recess is not blanket glazing.
Exterior walkway, concrete and beams; no additional material assignment proposed.
Interior glazing does not by itself localize an additional exterior aperture.
Close view separates expanded-metal outer skin from inner glazing and railing. Solid original mesh may receive only an opaque color proxy, not transparency or invented perforations.
Open terrace and mesh railing; no additional opaque glass or material selection.
Opposite high oblique supports identity and exclusions; sunset is not calibrated material color and does not justify recoloring the unseen rear screen bands.

five_final_views.finding: All selected families visible: narrow main window ribbon, turning high gray-box glazing, lower observed window band and two opaque silver-gray screen faces. Deep opening, its reveals/mullions and roof stay neutral. Most useful view; moderate local improvement versus same-scene mono, not full-building restoration.
Side oblique confirms that the observed long window band and only the visible skin are colored. The far short-side window family, opaque theater wall, structure and unverified regions remain neutral.

Directly observed +X skin and narrow turning ribbon visible. Large lower recess remains neutral and unfilled; adjacent rear screen-through bands remain neutral. Evidence boundary at the external corner is not claimed to be a physical material change.
Almost entirely neutral as intended; no mirrored front glazing or invented material proof on the rear screen bands.
Top planes, roof equipment and inner parapets remain neutral. Selected outer parapet face extent does not spill onto the roof.

same_scene_mono.finding: Compared against final front. Same current scene, camera, lighting and geometry; all face materials temporarily reset to neutral without saving. Not an historical original-preview match claim.

source_limits: Theater black box is a functional term, not permission to paint its exterior black. Its opaque main-wall faces remain neutral.
Expanded-metal skin is not glass. Selected solid original faces use only opaque, uncalibrated light silver-gray color; no fabricated perforations, transparency or interior fidelity.
Deep balcony recess, high shadow hole, unverified rear screen-through slots, lower side windows, roofs/equipment, edges, reveals, mullions and structure remain neutral.
Color/neutral discontinuities describe evidence scope, not necessarily real construction seams. Original coarse geometry and excluded adjacent pool/interiors/full terrain are unchanged.

face_scope.method: Whole original triangles only; all three vertices within six finite 2D plane intervals and matching actual normalized cross-product normals. Canonical IDs checked, no native-index assumption, no centroid/clip/retriangulation.
